plan.subject: Understand the fundamental concepts of linear regression, including its formulation, cost function, optimization techniques, and applications.
plan.objective: Understand the fundamental concepts of linear regression, including its formulation, cost function, optimization techniques, and applications.

blocks.title: What is Linear Regression?
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is a foundational technique for predicting continuous outcomes based on a linear relationship between variables.

blocks.title: Cost Function and Error Measurement
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function is essential for quantifying the error between predicted and actual values in linear regression.
examples: MSE (Mean Squared Error) as a differentiable and convex function

blocks.title: Gradient Descent for Optimization
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is a key optimization algorithm used to minimize the cost function in linear regression.

blocks.title: Linear Regression Modelling and Applications
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding how to model and apply linear regression is crucial for real-world data analysis.

blocks.title: Closed-Form Solution and Vectorization
blocks.teachingObjective: The closed-form solution and vectorization are alternative approaches for solving linear regression efficiently.
